observations: Three photos show a black, rectangular soundbar being held horizontally by a hand.
The soundbar has a glossy finish with visible smudges and minor scratches.
The brand name 'BOSE' is visible in white lettering on the front center of the soundbar in all three photos.
The background is a wooden-paneled wall with various audio accessories (headphones, earbuds) displayed on hooks.
A cardboard box labeled 'Hisense' and 'SONOS' is visible in the lower left of the photos.
Watermarks 'BACH STORES' and 'POSTED ON JIJI' are overlaid on the images.
The soundbar appears to be a single unit with no visible subwoofer or additional speakers in the photos.
